---
title: "How to take part"
---

If you'd like to take part, please read the [information sheet](assets/info_sheet_v3.pdf) and then complete the short [online screening questionnaire](https://psysurvey.plymouth.ac.uk/limesurvey/index.php?r=survey/index&sid=910001&lang=en). If everything is fine, we'll be in touch to arrange your first visit.

[Take the screening →](https://psysurvey.plymouth.ac.uk/limesurvey/index.php?r=survey/index&sid=910001&lang=en){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg} [Email us](mailto:dylan.curtin@plymouth.ac.uk?subject=TUS%20study){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-lg}

If you have any questions first, email **Dr Dylan Curtin** at [dylan.curtin@plymouth.ac.uk](mailto:dylan.curtin@plymouth.ac.uk?subject=TUS%20study).

The same address is the one to use for anything about your visits, such as rescheduling, a change in your health or medication, or if you decide to withdraw.

## Concerns or complaints

Contact the Faculty of Health Research Ethics and Integrity Committee at [Research.Ethics@plymouth.ac.uk](mailto:Research.Ethics@plymouth.ac.uk). For questions about your data, the University's Data Protection Officer is [dpo@plymouth.ac.uk](mailto:dpo@plymouth.ac.uk).
